comment: Most Ras instances treated as the RAS family (expanded to HRAS/KRAS/NRAS). GTP/GDP bound forms represented as complexes (protein + chemical). RAF family members mapped to RAF1 (C-RAF) and BRAF as appropriate. Inhibited Raf species (iRaf1, iBRaf, nfpi*, nfp*) were represented as either complexes including sorafenib (chemical) when the reaction shows direct binding to sorafenib, or as protein variants when context indicates a modified/inactive RAF form. MEK and ERK families expanded to MAP2K1/2 and MAPK1/3 respectively. GRB2_SOS, EG2SOS, and EG2 annotated as complexes with listed protein components. mE/mEL/mELmEL were left as unknown because the model context does not unambiguously identify them as a standard molecule.
